name: Weekly Dev Summary with Claude API

parameters.text:
=You are a development team summary writer. Generate a concise weekly dev summary in Markdown.

Data:
{{JSON.stringify($json, null, 2)}}

Format:
# Weekly Dev Summary - {{new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}}

## 📊 Stats
- Total commits: ...
- Merged PRs: ...
- Active contributors: ...

## 🏆 Top Contributors
...

## 🔀 Merged Pull Requests
...

## 📝 Key Changes
(Group commits by theme/feature area)
...

## 🎯 Focus Areas for Next Week
(Based on patterns observed)
...

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ description: `Weekly Dev Summary - ${$json.week}`, public: false, files: { [`weekly-summary-${$json.week}.md`]: { content: $json.markdown } } }) }}
